media.what: Sabato's Crystal Ball moved the Oklahoma governor race between Mike Mazzei and Cyndi Munson from Safe Republican to Likely Republican.

research.summary: Trump endorsed former state Sen. Mike Mazzei is favored for the open seat in a state no Democrat has won for governor since 2006, though a small Cross Timbers poll in mid October showed him only three points ahead of House Minority Leader Cyndi Munson. Mazzei is running on eliminating the income tax while Munson stresses public schools, affordability and a public vote on the abortion ban, and national groups have now put $3.5 million into the race.

issues.why: Mazzei says he will cut taxes and eliminate the state income tax, pointing to tax cuts he passed as finance chairman.
Munson cites nearly 4,000 emergency certified teachers and opposes private school vouchers, while Mazzei backs parental choice.

issues.issue: AI data centers and the Inola smelter
issues.why: The candidates clashed over water use by data centers and a $255 million incentive for an aluminum smelter in Inola.
Munson says half of counties lack an OB GYN, while Mazzei says Medicaid has $1.6 billion in questionable spending each year.
Munson supports letting voters reconsider the state's abortion restrictions.

storylines.title: Governors groups put in $3.5 million
storylines.what: The Republican Governors Association committed $3 million for Mazzei and the Democratic Governors Association $500,000 for Munson.

storylines.title: Munson hits $11 million self loan
storylines.what: Munson has criticized Mazzei's roughly $11 million in personal loans to his campaign.

storylines.title: Poll shows close race
storylines.what: A Cross Timbers poll of likely voters had Mazzei 39 and Munson 36, with a very wide margin of error and many Republicans undecided.

storylines.title: Fact check of the debate
storylines.what: The Frontier rated Munson's teacher and housing claims true and Mazzei's Medicaid waste claim mixed.

storylines.title: Debate moved for Trump rally
storylines.what: The OETA debate was pre taped in the morning so Mazzei could attend a Trump rally in Durant, where Munson pitched herself as a governor for all Oklahomans.

storylines.title: Trump lifts Mazzei in runoff
storylines.what: Trump endorsed Mazzei and called Drummond a fake Republican before the runoff, and Mazzei thanked him for help across the finish line.

events.title: Eliminate the income tax
events.prompt: A plan to phase out the state income tax is the centerpiece of the Republican campaign, while schools face a shortage of certified teachers. Where does the campaign stand on taxes?

opts.label: Fund schools first
opts.say: Oppose eliminating the income tax and spend on teacher pay and classrooms.

opts.label: Targeted relief
opts.say: Cut the grocery tax and property taxes for seniors while keeping school funding whole.

opts.label: Zero income tax
opts.say: Phase out the income tax and pay for it by ending corporate welfare.

events.title: Data centers and smelter
events.prompt: Large AI data centers and a $255 million incentive for an aluminum smelter in Inola have residents worried about water and pollution. How does the campaign respond?

opts.label: End the giveaways
opts.say: Oppose tax breaks for the smelter and demand strict water rules for data centers.

opts.label: Local say
opts.say: Let communities vote on big projects and require water use disclosure.

opts.label: Welcome investment
opts.say: Say modern cooling and smelter technology are safe and the jobs are worth it.

events.title: Trump rally conflict
events.prompt: The televised debate was moved to the morning so the Republican could attend a Trump rally in Durant. How does the campaign use Trump in a state he won by over 30 points?

opts.label: Oklahoma first
opts.say: Say Oklahoma needs a governor focused on home, not national partisan politics.

opts.label: Stay local
opts.say: Avoid Trump and talk only about state issues like roads and schools.

opts.label: Rally with Trump
opts.say: Stand with the president and promise to carry his agenda in Oklahoma.

events.title: Abortion ban vote
events.prompt: Democrats want voters to be able to reconsider the state's abortion ban, in one of the most conservative states. How does the campaign handle the issue?

opts.label: Let voters decide
opts.say: Back a statewide vote on the ban and stress OB GYN shortages.

opts.label: Exceptions only
opts.say: Support clearer medical exceptions without a full vote on the ban.

opts.label: Defend the ban
opts.say: Say Oklahoma's pro life law reflects its values and should stand.

regions.name: Oklahoma City metro
regions.note: Oklahoma County is the most competitive large county, with Norman's university vote and red suburbs around it.

regions.name: Tulsa metro
regions.note: Mazzei's home base, with a Democratic leaning core city surrounded by heavily Republican suburbs.

regions.name: Green Country and northeast
regions.note: Once Democratic tribal and rural areas that now vote solidly Republican.

regions.name: Little Dixie and southeast
regions.note: Old Democratic territory turned deep red, home to the Durant Trump rally.

regions.name: Western Oklahoma and Panhandle
regions.note: The most Republican part of the state, driven by farming, energy and the Lawton military base.
